```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential debhelper dh-make devscripts libssl-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libsqlite3-dev libpq-dev libmysqlclient-dev

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@98c8021b550208e191a6a3145459bfc9fb29c4c0 # v2
        with:
          shared-key: ppa-build

      - name: Build Debian package
        run: |
          mkdir -p target/debian
          ./scripts/build-deb.sh

      - name: Setup GPG
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg@e89d40939c28e39f97cf32126055eeae86ba74ec # v6
        with:
          gpg_private_key: ${{ secrets.MISE_GPG_KEY }}
          git_user_signingkey: true
          git_commit_gpgsign: true
          git_tag_gpgsign: true

      - name: Publish to Launchpad
        run: |
          # Install launchpadlib
          pip install launchpadlib
          
          # Configure git for launchpad
          git config --global user.name "mise-bot"
          git config --global user.email "mise-bot@example.com"
          
          # Create source package
          cd target/debian
          dpkg-source -b mise_$(cat ../VERSION).orig.tar.gz
          
          # Upload to Launchpad
          dput ppa:jdx/mise mise_$(cat ../VERSION)_source.changes
        env:
          LP_USER: ${{ secrets.LP_USER }}
          LP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.LP_PASSWORD }}
```
